notes: Mexico freight v1, Laredo only. US-side border transfer yards: southbound trailers are dropped here for a transfer carrier to take across, northbound trailers are picked up here after a transfer carrier has brought them across. No Mexican city is ever a map city, route or destination; consignee cities appear only as text on the load. Yard paperwork waits are a gameplay range, not border data.

area.note: Laredo area box used by the data checks: the city pin, the Mines Road and Interstate 35 north industrial area, and the World Trade Bridge approach.

yards.name: On Time International
yards.source_note: Read: On Time International Laredo cross-dock, minutes from the Laredo-Nuevo Laredo crossing, trailer-to-trailer transfer (https://ontimeinternational.com/cross-dock-laredo-tx). Pin derived: OpenStreetMap Nominatim house-level geocode of 14602 Atlanta Dr, Laredo, TX 78045 (way 852711310), accessed 2026-10-14.

yards.name: SCI Cross Dock
yards.address: 11903 Auburn Rd, Ste. A, Laredo, TX 78045
yards.source_note: Read: SCI Cross Dock, El Portal Industrial Park, cross-border trailer transfers and trailer yard ten minutes from the World Trade Bridge (https://sci-cross-dock.com/). Pin derived: OpenStreetMap Nominatim house-level geocode of 11903 Auburn Rd, Laredo, TX 78045 (way 21302460), accessed 2026-10-14.

consignees.name: Monterrey, Nuevo León
consignees.source: Federal Highway 85D runs from Nuevo Laredo to Monterrey. Automotive Logistics (https://www.automotivelogistics.media/supply-chain/down-mexico-wayand-back-again/179375) describes the Monterrey and Saltillo to Chicago and Detroit truck lane through Laredo.

consignees.name: Saltillo, Coahuila
consignees.source: Saltillo traffic from Nuevo Laredo uses Federal Highways 40 and 57, not 85D. Automotive Logistics (https://www.automotivelogistics.media/supply-chain/down-mexico-wayand-back-again/179375) reports GM Ramos Arizpe, by Saltillo, ships about 95 percent of its output via Laredo on the Monterrey and Saltillo to Chicago and Detroit lane. Stellantis Saltillo Truck Assembly: https://media.stellantisnorthamerica.com/newsrelease.do?id=319.

bridge.name: World Trade Bridge
bridge.note: Story text only. The game never times, charges or crosses the bridge. The Saturday evening pilot hours are left out on purpose.

weekday.spoken: it normally takes commercial traffic 7 AM to midnight on weekdays

saturday.spoken: it opens to commercial traffic at 8 AM and normally closes at 4 PM on Saturdays

sunday.spoken: it normally takes commercial traffic 8 AM to 4 PM on Sundays

paperwork_wait_minutes.note: Assumed: a plausible gameplay range for a northbound trailer's paperwork at the yard, drawn from the job's own seed. Not a measured border or yard wait.

text.load_card: for consignee {consignee}, delivered to {yard} in {city} for a transfer carrier to take across
text.yard_drop: Trailer dropped at {yard}. A transfer carrier takes it across from here to {consignee}.
text.northbound_wait: The northbound trailer at {yard} is still on paperwork. About {minutes} minutes before it is released, logged on duty, not driving.
text.northbound_wait_after_hours: The World Trade Bridge is closed to trucks right now; {hours}. This trailer came across before it closed. About {minutes} minutes of paperwork before it is released, logged on duty, not driving.
text.no_load_ready: No northbound trailer is ready at the Laredo yards right now. The trailer missed the last crossing and will be ready in the morning.
